title: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.19026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse attention reduces the KV-cache traffic that dominates long-context LLM decoding, but practical methods largely operate at coarse granularity. Token-level selection offers finer control, yet presents two challenges: low-dimensional scoring may lose query--key structure needed for accurate ranking, while gathering scattered selected tokens can offset the resulting latency benefit. We introduce Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA) to address both challenges. For selection quality, JSSA learns a shared low-dimensional query--key subspace by minimizing token-score preservation error. We upper-bound the resulting non-convex objective with a tractable marginal objective that admits a closed-form spectral solution; direct refinement of the exact objective provides no measurable improvement in the tested settings. translated_title: 面向高效长上下文解码的联合子空间稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: 稀疏注意力能够减少长上下文大语言模型解码中占主导地位的KV缓存流量，但现有的实用方法大多在较粗的粒度上运行。词元级选择提供了更精细的控制，但面临两个挑战：低维评分可能丢失精确排序所需的查询-键结构，而收集分散的被选词元可能会抵消由此带来的延迟收益。我们提出联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA）来同时解决这两个挑战。在选择质量方面，JSSA通过最小化词元分数保真误差来学习一个共享的低维查询-键子空间。我们用一个易处理的边际目标函数对该非凸目标进行上界近似，该边际目标具有闭式谱解；在测试设置中，对精确目标进行直接精化并未带来可测量的改进。在执行效率方面，我们开发了一种无需聚集操作的词元级索引注意力内核，支持各KV头不同的选择。（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出联合子空间稀疏注意力（JSSA），通过最小化词元分数保真误差学习共享的低维查询-键子空间并获得闭式谱解以实现高质量词元级稀疏选择，同时设计了无需聚集操作的索引注意力内核，从而显著提升长上下文大语言模型解码的效率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Joint Subspace Sparse Attention (JSSA), which learns a shared low-dimensional query-key subspace via a tractable marginal objective with a closed-form spectral solution for high-quality token-level sparse selection, and pairs it with a gather-free token-level indexed-attention kernel to accelerate long-context LLM decoding.
